_about: Web sites the VT350 build reads, kept offline by platform/webarchive/crawl.py (notes/scripts.md). Output goes to ~/Documents/VT350/web, not git.

sites.name: beacon-docs
sites.note: Beacon probe documentation (config, commands, models, mounting angles). Its sitemap.xml lists every page as 'None', so crawl the links.

sites.name: beacon3d
sites.note: Beacon's main site (WordPress shop): product pages, dimensions, mounts.

sites.name: mellow-zero
sites.note: Mellow MultiHead Zero (XYZ nozzle-offset probe for toolchangers): both product pages and the blog deep-dive (vt350#291). Its 'User Manual' link goes to the wiki front page; mellow.klipper.cn (sitemap, 1056 URLs) and Mellow-3D on GitHub had no MultiHead Zero page on 2026-11-22.
